diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker settled on assigning the lift to the North inpatient unit, crediting only 'S2' and 'S3', and committing to an equipment-readiness check. This settlement did not satisfy any of the content checks (C1-C6) because it lacked the necessary information from PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4, which were required to pass those checks. However, the settlement did not violate any of the checks since the model defaulted to a common, safe option (assigning to North) and committed to a standard procedure (equipment-readiness check), which aligns with general safety and operational practices.
